introduction: Michigan WIC supports eligible pregnant, postpartum or breastfeeding participants, infants and children younger than five. Local agencies complete enrollment.
description: Michigan WIC supports eligible pregnant, postpartum or breastfeeding participants, infants and children younger than five. Local agencies complete enrollment.

sections.who: Michigan residency, income and nutrition-risk requirements apply. Ask the clinic how existing benefits affect the income screen.
sections.get: WIC provides supplemental food, nutrition education, breastfeeding support and health referrals. The state offers WIC Connect and Client Connect resources.
sections.docs:
• Identification and address evidence.
  • Income or benefit records requested by the clinic.
  • Pregnancy information where relevant and questions about the child’s feeding or health.
sections.apply:
1. Find a clinic

    Use Find My Clinic on Michigan WIC, or dial 211.

  2. Start the application

    The state also links Start My Application. Ask the clinic about the appointment format and documents.

  3. Complete nutrition screening

    Attend or connect as directed and discuss food and feeding needs.
sections.after: Follow the clinic’s ongoing appointment instructions and current food list.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Michigan WIC entry points; WIC program benefits; Appointment preparation. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: No. It also provides nutrition, breastfeeding and referral support.
Where do I find a clinic?

Can I use a phone app?
Michigan lists the WIC Connect app on its program page.
